name: PleasrDAO
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Nansen CEO Alex Svanevik tweeted that the Twitter account of PleasrDAO, a decentralized autonomous organization composed of DeFi leaders, early NFT collectors, and digital artists, has been stolen, reminding users not to interact with it. PleasrDAO’s official Twitter account tweeted about the claim of the fake token PLEASR.
